description.sr: Nastavnikov spisak četvrtog časa (23.10.2026), zapisivan redom vođenja spiska; broj uz zapis je broj fotografija tog rada. Uz spisak su zavedene i ispravke ranijih zapisa trećeg časa.
description.en: The teacher’s list of the fourth class (23 October 2026), recorded in the order the list was kept; the number beside an entry is that work’s photograph count. Corrections to earlier third-class records are filed with the list.
